'''Anthony James Merrill Spencer''' (23 August 1929 — 26 January 2008) [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]]<ref name="frs"/> was an applied mathematician whose main field of research was in understanding and predicting the mechanical behaviour of advanced materials.<ref name="mathgene">{{MathGenealogy|id=95551}}</ref><ref name="mactutor">{{MacTutor|id=Spencer_Tony}}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
Spencer was elected a [[List of Fellows of the Royal Society elected in 1987|Fellow of the Royal Society (FRS) in 1987]].<ref name="frs"/>
